theme.description: The current theme. Drives the icon and aria-pressed.

variant.description: Names the page transition and sets the small icon nudge that matches it.

onThemeChange.description: Called on press with the opposite theme, the variant, and the button, so the page transition can start from it.

label.description: Accessible name. Defaults to "Switch to dark mode" or "Switch to light mode".

iconOnly.description: Hides the "Switch theme" text and renders a 38px square button.
